course_name_original: Russian B2 course - compulsory course of 135 hours for students of FIRST-CYCLE studies - semester 1/3
course_name_en: Russian B2 course - compulsory course of 135 hours for FIRST-CYCLE students - semester 1/3
prerequisites: Russian language proficiency at least at A-2 level.

learning_outcomes.text: Can write understandable informative and argumentative texts on general and industry topics, conduct correspondence typical for the work environment, and independently use didactic materials.
Can clearly present conclusions and opinions on general, academic, and professional topics in written and oral form.
Understands longer, even complex written and oral statements, e.g., lectures and presentations, provided they concern industry issues and current affairs, and can interpret the acquired information.

Can use grammatical constructions, phraseology, and vocabulary that allow for understanding general texts describing contemporary economic and social phenomena, academic and industry-specific texts, and allow for fairly fluent and spontaneous communication in academic and professional environments.
Can prepare an oral presentation on academic and industry topics and participate fairly fluently and spontaneously in discussions, including in a professional environment.

syllabus_topics: Russian language B-2 – compulsory course 135 hours - semester 1/3: Classes within the module are conducted in the form of exercises (135 hours) GRAMMATICAL ISSUES . Noun: • accusative plural of animate nouns • neuter nouns ending in –мя, e.g., время (revision) • acronyms like турпоход, шоп-тур . Adjective: • comparative degree, superlative degree with suffixes –eйш-, -aйш- and prefix най- • short form as predicate. . Pronoun: • negative with particles ни, не(-), e.g., ничего, нечего • indefinite with particles -то, -нибудь, e.g., кто-то, кто-нибудь. . Verb: • perfective, imperfective verbs (e.g., лететь - летать) • imperative mood for 3rd person singular and plural and for 1st person plural • verbs of motion (куда? +B.) and state (где? + Msc.) • adverbial and adjectival participles (active and passive) • passive voice . Sentence constructions: • cardinal numeral 2, 3, 4 + adjective + masculine or neuter noun. . Translation attempts. TOPICS AND VOCABULARY University, studies, student life (Вуз, учёба, студенческая жизнь) - Education in Poland and Russia, choosing a university - Description of the faculty and nature of studies Plans for the future, choosing a profession (Планы на будущее, выбор профессии) - Applying for a job - Ways for students to earn money Dying and most prestigious professions (Исчезающие и престижные профессии) - Naming professions and describing professional activities Job interview (Собеседование) - Ability to present oneself during a job interview, dress code Job offers in the press or on the Internet (Оферты работы, объявления) - Creating job advertisements, employment agency Examples of formal letters, e.g., application, complaint, cover letter (Коммерческая корреспонденция) - Writing various forms of formal letters; business correspondence Office equipment and supplies (Оргтехника) - Ordering office supplies, names of office equipment Passport and visa formalities (Оформление визы) - Asking questions, providing information, writing invitations Filling out forms, e.g., customs declaration (Как заполнить таможенную декларацию) - Types of customs and visa forms, blanks Booking a hotel room (Бронировка номера в отеле) - Ability to book accommodation, tickets, etc. At the station, at the airport (Ha вокзалe, в аэропортy) - Most important places, e.g., waiting room, terminal, timetable; activities related to travel Sport and tourism (Спорт и туризм) - Sports disciplines, pros and cons of practicing sports - Sporting events and facilities Health status, doctor (Врач, болезнь) - Treatment, first aid - Medical specialties, medical supplies, etc. The environment we live in (Окружающая среда) - Ecological threats and environmental protection - Pro-ecological behaviors Us and culture (Мы и культурa) - Cultural events - Film, music, museum Technology around us, the Internet (Техника вокруг нас, Интернет) - Inventions, electronic devices, computer - The role of the Internet, rules of etiquette on the Internet Holidays and celebrations in Poland and Russia (Государственные и церковные праздники) - Holiday attributes, sending wishes LANGUAGE FUNCTIONS and OTHER SKILLS Conducting discussions – Проведение дискуссии Commenting on information – Комментарии Conducting conversations about everyday situations – Разговоры на бытовые темы Giving advice – Советы Expressing wishes – Желания Forecasting – Прогнозирование Stating reasons – Представление причин Resolving conflicts, reacting in conflict situations. Conducting conversations about rules of behavior. Conducting short conversations with casually met people. Justifying one's position, citing arguments "for" and "against", constructive criticism. Preparing and conducting a job interview. Filling out forms. Editing various types of texts: emails and private and official letters, e.g., cover letter, CV, letters to the editor, complaints, applications. Listening comprehension of interviews, general conversations, and popular science statements. Reading comprehension of popular science texts. Conducting a presentation related to the field of study.
assessment_rules: The condition for passing is to receive a positive grade from all colloquia conducted during the semester. If a negative grade is received, the student has the right to improve the grade according to specific rules, including two retake colloquia. An unjustified absence from a test results in losing the attempt. The final grade for the language course is determined as the arithmetic mean of all grades obtained by the student from passing individual semesters and the foreign language exam.
